title: Today In Golf
summary: A 30-second briefing on today’s biggest golf stories.

items.headline: Nicklaus Critiques PGA Schedule
items.text: Jack Nicklaus said the PGA Tour’s schedule is too crowded with big events close together, making it hard for smaller tournaments to attract top players and leaving little time for players to recharge.

items.headline: Rahm Backs Off LIV Funding Pitch
items.text: Jon Rahm stated he is not helping LIV Golf seek new investors because he knows nothing about business and prefers to focus on playing golf, unlike Bryson DeChambeau who is involved in the investor push.
